alignments.note: The construct chain דְּבַר־שֶׁקֶר is rendered by the single word *lying*, so the two morphemes share one unit under rule 30, headed on the morpheme whose lexeme that word writes. That the word is שֶׁקֶר's ordinary rendering does not defeat the condition, as rule 30 states for `אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה` → *harlot's*.
Anarthrous substantival adjective completed by a supplied generic *man*; head stays on the word carrying the lexeme under rule 31.
Substantival adjective with supplied *a* and generic *man*.
Hiphil verb rendered by copula plus adjective; headed on the word carrying the lexeme under rule 44.
Light verb with its complement, headed on *shame* under rule 44. Margin *Or, causeth shame and bringeth reproach* read and set aside under rule 38.

review_notes: דְּבַר־שֶׁקֶר is fused under rule 30 rather than split with דָּבָר unrepresented; splitting would leave one morpheme holding the whole word while the other went unmarked, which rule 30 forbids.
